title: Why aren't we all using heat pumps?
summary: Distilled argues heat pumps are an overlooked climate solution held back by cheap fossil fuels, unpriced pollution and gas-industry lobbying, and that they work in cold climates.

assertions.quote: they move heat rather than generate it
a heat pump is an appliance that can both heat and cool a building
today's heat pumps work down to -20° F or or -30° C
if you've ever heard that heat pumps don't work in cold climates you can probably thank your local gas company
just ask Scandinavians in Norway Finland and Sweden
your local government will give you thousands of dollars in rebates to do so
